FeatureLineageCaveat: Phase-3 frozen 123 legacy_v1 columns cannot all be reused with verified safe semantics; seven corrected pre-match strength/form columns used for direct and matched historical Poisson folds

ClassPolicy.Matrix: outer product of exact 0..6 probabilities, normalized on grid
ClassPolicy.Selection: stable row-major global argmax; no score weighting
ClassPolicy.ChosenFrom: strictly pre-2024/25 training support; diagnostic outcomes excluded

Model: two independent XGBoost multi:softprob classifiers, unweighted
RateReference: matched-feature XGB count:poisson on historical folds only; frozen Phase-3 independent on diagnostic
Fill: numeric train median separately per fold; zero only if entire training column missing
